lines.zh: 我扛着斧子走，斧刃刮着石墙。
lines.en: I walk with the axe shouldered, its edge scraping stone.

lines.zh: 这扇门我从里面开过一千次。
lines.en: I have opened this door from the inside a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我踩过村庄的石板路，没人拦我。
lines.en: I cross the village cobbles and no one stops me.

lines.zh: 菌丝缠住斧柄，握起来更稳。
lines.en: Mycelium wraps the haft and my grip is steadier.

lines.zh: 我走路时肩膀一高一低。
lines.en: One shoulder rides higher than the other as I walk.

lines.zh: 我记得突袭那晚的火把。
lines.en: I remember the torches on the night of the raid.

lines.zh: 我绕过陷阱，这双靴子认得路。
lines.en: I walk around the traps; these boots know the way.

lines.zh: 门闩挡不住我，我伸手一推。
lines.en: A latch will not stop me; I push it open.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声很沉，地板都在响。
lines.en: My steps are heavy and the floorboards answer.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊走到尽头，再折回来。
lines.en: I walk the corridor to its end and come back.

lines.zh: 斧子太重，我换了个肩。
lines.en: The axe is heavy; I shift it to the other shoulder.

lines.zh: 我跨过同伴的残骸，没有低头。
lines.en: I step over a companion's remains without looking down.

lines.zh: 我拄着斧柄站着，像在等命令。
lines.en: I stand on the axe haft as if awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 我用拇指试了试斧刃。
lines.en: I test the axe edge with my thumb.

lines.zh: 远处有钟声，我抬头听了很久。
lines.en: A bell rings far off; I listen a long while.

lines.zh: 我把门一扇扇推开，又关上。
lines.en: I push doors open one by one, then shut them.

lines.zh: 菌丝从领口钻出来，我不管。
lines.en: Mycelium creeps from my collar and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是 Hunter，又不太确定。
lines.en: I remember being a Hunter. Then I am not sure.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的手掌，纹路全变了。
lines.en: I stare at my palm; the lines have all changed.

lines.zh: 我把斧子立在墙角，靠着它歇。
lines.en: I stand the axe in the corner and lean on it.

lines.zh: 我数着屋里的门，一共四扇。
lines.en: I count the doors in this room: four.

lines.zh: 我清了清喉咙，只咳出孢子。
lines.en: I clear my throat and cough up only spores.

lines.zh: 我在墙上刻了一道，代表今天。
lines.en: I carve a mark on the wall for today.

lines.zh: 斧柄上的旧布条还系着。
lines.en: The old cloth strip is still tied to the haft.

lines.zh: 我把护甲上的菌斑刮掉一片。
lines.en: I scrape a patch of mold off my armor.

lines.zh: 我坐着，膝盖上的皮已经硬了。
lines.en: I sit; the skin over my knees has gone hard.

lines.zh: 我把斧子换个手，掌心发黏。
lines.en: I shift the axe to my other hand. My palm is sticky.

lines.zh: 窗外的菌丝又长高了一截。
lines.en: The mycelium outside the window has grown taller again.

lines.zh: 我试着回想自己的名字。
lines.en: I try to remember my own name.

lines.zh: 孢子落在斧面上，慢慢长开。
lines.en: Spores land on the axe head and slowly spread.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌举得不够高。
lines.en: You are not holding that shield high enough.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，先看有没有武器。
lines.en: I look at your hands, checking for a weapon first.

lines.zh: 我歪头，斧子跟着晃了一下。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the axe sways with it.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，让我想起同僚。
lines.en: The iron smell on you reminds me of my fellows.

lines.zh: 我认出你不是村民，也不是卫道士。
lines.en: I see you are neither villager nor vindicator.

lines.zh: 我抬手，像要行一个旧礼。
lines.en: I raise a hand as if to give an old salute.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住几斧。
lines.en: That armor of yours will not survive many swings.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最好下手。
lines.en: I stare at your knees; they are the easiest target.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找恐惧，找到了。
lines.en: I search your face for fear, and I find it.

lines.zh: 你握剑的姿势不对，我替你可惜。
lines.en: Your grip on that sword is wrong. A pity.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处反光，你没注意。
lines.en: My eyes catch the light in the dark; you miss it.

lines.zh: 我点了一下头，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: I nod once, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 四层护甲挡了一下，只留个坑。
lines.en: Four layers of armor take it and leave a dent.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，斧子握得更紧。
lines.en: I grunt once and grip the axe tighter.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肩，那里菌最厚。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder, where the fungus is thickest.

lines.zh: 二十八点生命，够你砍一阵。
lines.en: Twenty-eight hit points will keep you swinging a while.

lines.zh: 我不退，退了就不算卫道士。
lines.en: I do not retreat; retreating would unmake me.

lines.zh: 伤口流出的东西是绿的，别碰。
lines.en: What leaks from the wound is green. Do not touch it.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的斧势。
lines.en: That blow broke the arc of my swing.

lines.zh: 我把受伤的肩膀转开，继续走。
lines.en: I turn my wounded shoulder away and keep walking.

lines.zh: 疼得发麻，我反倒站稳了。
lines.en: The pain numbs me, and oddly I stand firmer.

lines.zh: 你再打两下，我也还能开门。
lines.en: Two more hits and I can still open a door.

lines.zh: 你手里那把斧子，给我看看。
lines.en: That axe in your hand. Let me see it.

lines.zh: 铁锭的味道，比什么都香。
lines.en: The smell of an iron ingot beats everything.

lines.zh: 我伸手要你的武器，不是要你的命。
lines.en: I reach for your weapon, not your life.

lines.zh: 你把铁斧举高，我的头就跟上去。
lines.en: You raise the iron axe and my head follows.

lines.zh: 我磨斧子的石头，你带了吗？
lines.en: Did you bring the whetstone for my axe?

lines.zh: 一块铁，能让我安静很久。
lines.en: One piece of iron keeps me quiet for a long time.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只因为那把斧子。
lines.en: I follow you only because of that axe.

lines.zh: 我闻到你背包里有铁器。
lines.en: I smell ironwork inside your pack.

lines.zh: 放下，退后，我就不追了。
lines.en: Put it down, step back, and I will not chase.

lines.zh: 我抓住斧柄的样子，像在握手。
lines.en: I grip the haft the way others shake hands.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你自己会退两步。
lines.en: Bump me and you will be the one stepping back.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀是硬的，你该绕开。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard; you should go around.

lines.zh: 护甲四层，压得我脚步很沉。
lines.en: Four layers of armor make my steps heavy.

lines.zh: 你撞上斧柄，磕得不轻。
lines.en: You walk into the axe haft. That had to hurt.

lines.zh: 我不躲，我从来都直着走。
lines.en: I do not dodge; I always walk straight ahead.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，菌丝掉了两片。
lines.en: We collide and two flakes of mycelium fall.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，没用多少力。
lines.en: I shoulder you aside without much effort.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我的护腿。
lines.en: Your knee knocks against my leggings.

lines.zh: 我站定不动，等你自己让开。
lines.en: I plant my feet and wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 撞我的代价，你马上就懂。
lines.en: The price of shoving me is about to be clear.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，像两把并排的斧子。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, like two axes side by side.

lines.zh: 她握斧的姿势，和我一模一样。
lines.en: She holds her axe exactly as I do.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只看同一扇门。
lines.en: We say nothing and watch the same door.

lines.zh: 同类之间，靠菌丝认人。
lines.en: Kin recognize each other by the mycelium.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着这条走廊。
lines.en: We take turns guarding this corridor.

lines.zh: 她的护甲上也有四道刻痕。
lines.en: Her armor carries the same four notches.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一片干菌，算是信物。
lines.en: We trade a dry scrap of fungus as a token.

lines.zh: 并肩时，我的斧子会朝外偏。
lines.en: Standing beside her, my axe angles outward.

lines.zh: 我替她挡过一次门，她记得。
lines.en: I held a door for her once; she remembers.

lines.zh: 两只卫道士一起，门就关不上。
lines.en: With two vindicators here, no door stays shut.

lines.zh: 地上那把斧子，归我了。
lines.en: That axe on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡铁锭，斧子搁在一边。
lines.en: I bend for the iron ingot, axe set aside.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西，我先看是不是武器。
lines.en: For anything dropped, I check first if it is a weapon.

lines.zh: 我捡起盾牌，掂了掂，扔了。
lines.en: I pick up a shield, weigh it, and toss it away.

lines.zh: 这块铁片能补我的护腿。
lines.en: This iron scrap can patch my leggings.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进腰带，动作很熟。
lines.en: I tuck it into my belt with practiced ease.

lines.zh: 我捡起门闩，顺手装回门上。
lines.en: I pick up the latch and fit it back on the door.

lines.zh: 猎物掉的东西，都算战利品。
lines.en: Whatever the prey drops counts as spoils.

lines.zh: 我只拿得动一只手能握住的东西。
lines.en: I only take what one hand can hold.

lines.zh: 我捡起石头，在墙上又刻一道。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and carve another mark.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我最讨厌。
lines.en: That shield stance of yours is what I hate most.

lines.zh: 门开着，你无路可退。
lines.en: The door is open, and you have nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，从现在开始。
lines.en: I have marked you, starting now.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住斧刃，试试就知道。
lines.en: Your armor will not stop this edge. Try it.

lines.zh: 我把斧子换到惯用手。
lines.en: I shift the axe to my good hand.

lines.zh: 屋子里只有你和我，正好。
lines.en: Only you and I in this room. Perfect.

lines.zh: 你打断了我数门，我很恼火。
lines.en: You interrupted my counting of doors. I am annoyed.

lines.zh: 我看见你的盾了，它撑不了多久。
lines.en: I see your shield; it will not last long.

lines.zh: 别往楼梯跑，我比你熟。
lines.en: Do not run for the stairs; I know them better.

lines.zh: 这次不用命令，我自己想动手。
lines.en: No orders needed this time; I want this myself.

lines.zh: 我贴着门框，等你走出来。
lines.en: I press against the doorframe and wait for you to come out.

lines.zh: 斧刃朝下，我不想磕到墙。
lines.en: The edge points down; I do not want to chip the wall.

lines.zh: 我听着你的脚步，数到第三步。
lines.en: I listen to your steps and count to three.

lines.zh: 你在门后，我知道你在门后。
lines.en: You are behind that door. I know you are.

lines.zh: 我慢慢推门，铰链没响。
lines.en: I push the door slowly and the hinge stays quiet.

lines.zh: 我记得你刚才站在哪块砖上。
lines.en: I remember which tile you were standing on.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，那里正合我意。
lines.en: You back into the corner, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 菌丝替我指方向，它闻得到你。
lines.en: The mycelium points the way; it can smell you.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压得很低，几乎听不见。
lines.en: I keep my breathing low, almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 再走两步，就到斧子的距离了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you are within axe reach.

lines.zh: 七点加九点，这一斧就是这个数。
lines.en: Seven plus nine: that is what this axe delivers.

lines.zh: 你的盾被我劈开一条口子。
lines.en: My swing splits a gap in your shield.

lines.zh: 盾牌暂时不管用了，你知道吧。
lines.en: Your shield is dead for a moment. You noticed?

lines.zh: 我劈下去，木头和骨头一起响。
lines.en: I swing down; wood and bone crack together.

lines.zh: 我双手握柄，把力气全压下去。
lines.en: I grip with both hands and drive all my weight down.

lines.zh: 你挡，我就再劈同一处。
lines.en: Block it and I will split the same spot again.

lines.zh: 斧刃卡在护甲里，我拔出来。
lines.en: The edge lodges in your armor; I wrench it free.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是浪费时间。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes time.

lines.zh: 你退一步，斧子就够不到了。
lines.en: One step back and the axe cannot reach you.

lines.zh: 斧子落下，比上一次更狠。
lines.en: The axe comes down harder than the last time.

lines.zh: 我死在突袭里，斧子还握在手上。
lines.en: I died in the raid with the axe still in my grip.

lines.zh: 黑暗里站起来时，我先找门。
lines.en: Rising in the dark, I look for a door first.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门是我开的。
lines.en: I am the one who opened this room's door.

lines.zh: 菌丝把我从地上拉起来，很慢。
lines.en: The mycelium pulls me up from the floor, slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得最后的命令，还没做完。
lines.en: I remember the last order. It is unfinished.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，斧刃就在脸旁边。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, the axe edge is by my face.

lines.zh: 屋外的火把还亮着，我已经不需要了。
lines.en: The torches outside still burn; I no longer need them.

lines.zh: 我从塌陷的地板下面钻上来。
lines.en: I climb up through the collapsed floorboards.

lines.zh: 二十八个心跳之后，我站了起来。
lines.en: Twenty-eight heartbeats later, I stand up.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着四层护甲。
lines.en: I came into this state wearing four layers of armor.

lines.zh: 我站起来，先摸了摸背后那扇门。
lines.en: I stand and first touch the door behind me.

lines.zh: 有人在屋里点了灯，我偏不去那间。
lines.en: Someone lit a lamp indoors; I avoid that room.

lines.zh: 斧柄着了火，我只好换手。
lines.en: The haft catches fire, so I switch hands.

lines.zh: 落地时斧子脱手，滑出很远。
lines.en: The axe leaves my hand on landing and slides far.

lines.zh: 水没到胸口，斧子拖着我往下。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and the axe drags me down.

lines.zh: 我被炸得跪地，斧子还在手上。
lines.en: The blast drops me to one knee; the axe stays in hand.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在护肩上，没进肉。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my pauldron without reaching flesh.

lines.zh: 魔法打在我身上，护甲烫得发红。
lines.en: Magic hits me and my armor glows red hot.

lines.zh: 肚子空着，斧子却还举得起来。
lines.en: My stomach is empty, but the axe still lifts.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着斧子走，我手臂全麻。
lines.en: The bolt runs down the axe and numbs my whole arm.

lines.zh: 虚空吞掉了斧子的重量，也吞掉了我。
lines.en: The void swallows the weight of my axe, then me.
